themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks, interacting with systems, and managing research processes autonomously or semi-autonomously.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and manage code, including identifying vulnerabilities.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is used in the UI/UX design process, from generating designs to aiding designers in their workflows.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Articles discussing AI applications for creating, analyzing, and managing surveys, as well as the insights derived from them.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the development, capabilities, and potential issues of AI chatbots, particularly in areas like information dissemination and user interaction.

themes.name: AI research tools broad
themes.description: Encompasses a wide range of AI applications and news relevant to research, including new models, company updates, and industry news.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Examines the creation and use of artificial entities or data that mimic human users for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers platforms and tools that integrate AI to streamline and accelerate various aspects of research and development.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as articles, research papers, or transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Discusses AI applications in understanding product development, market analysis, and the impact of AI on product roadmaps.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
